title: Are In-Context Images Worth 10 Dimensions?
abstract: arXiv:2609.37659v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: There has been significant work on understanding the In-Context Learning capabilities of Large Language Models, especially on the induction circuit. For a few-shot classification task, the induction circuit leverages linear representations of each labeled example in-context in order to classify an unlabeled query. However, few works focus on how those linear representations are built in the first place. Leveraging the expressivity of the vision modality compared to text, we uncover a Shared Discriminative Geometry (SDG) inside Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs). It is a low-dimensional space, shared across all image classification tasks, in which in-context images are compressed into linearly separable representations later used to perform classification. translated_title: 上下文中的图像值10个维度吗？
translated_abstract: 在理解大语言模型的上下文学习能力方面，尤其是关于归纳电路的研究，已有大量工作。对于少样本分类任务，归纳电路利用上下文中每个带标签样本的线性表示来对未标记的查询进行分类。然而，很少有工作关注这些线性表示最初是如何构建的。借助视觉模态相较于文本模态更强的表现力，我们揭示了大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）内部的一种共享判别几何，这是一个在所有图像分类任务之间共享的低维空间，上下文中的图像在该空间中被压缩为线性可分的表示，随后用于执行分类。我们观察到，这是模型在早期层中对视觉表示进行降维处理的结果。为了解释这一现象：（1）我们展示了分析……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了大视觉语言模型内部存在一个跨所有图像分类任务共享的低维“共享判别几何”空间，上下文图像在早期层被降维压缩为线性可分的表示，从而支撑少样本分类。
en_tdlr: This paper uncovers a Shared Discriminative Geometry (SDG) in Large Vision Language Models—a low-dimensional space shared across all image classification tasks, where in-context images are compressed through early-layer dimensionality reduction into linearly separable representations that enable few-shot classification.
